review.cancellationEligibility: camera_only is frozen at spawn from matching job/displayed revision and worldId. New source accepted but not yet displayed has camera_only=false permanently for that job.
review.synchronization: Cancellation request/reached/stage/timestamps are protected by Mutex. A request alone does not count as a reached checkpoint.
review.race: A completed camera refresh superseded by an accepted revision is skipped before water bake and checked again after an awaited bake. A source job not yet displayed is not skipped.
review.progress: When cancelled/obsolete camera work finishes, latest accepted world is scheduled immediately; the displayed snapshot remains intact. A stream of newer previews cannot keep cancelling an accepted-unrendered job.
review.preservedBehavior: Physical lineage and older-than-displayed guards remain unchanged. Height/prefilter/colour arithmetic and population selection are unchanged on non-cancelled paths.
review.counters: cancelledSuperseded records worker results returned after a real hit checkpoint; skippedCameraRefresh records the actual completion skip branch, not request_cancel calls.
review.instrumentation: ScenePrepare phase names now identify the completed stage, including detailMs,treeSupportMs,populationMs,buffersMs,hydrologyMs andurbanArraysMs.

verification.setup: Fresh ignored minimal project initialized with headless editor class scan, then copied test run. Fixture and frozen baseline paths supplied explicitly. ROOT and viewer tracked files were read-only.

limits: CPU code/control/output equivalence only; no fresh neural generation, GPU rendering or20s navigation campaign was run.
The six image comparisons use the authored retained layer fixture; they are not a new terrain provenance claim.
Full pipeline latency and visible progress still require the original strict20s qualification and native/display ledgers. V9/V10FAILED are preserved.
